history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Gagamaru polish
history.text: Awakening voice, audio and lighting revised; save pop-up and cosmetic issues fixed.

history.title: Gagamaru rework
history.text: Revised kit and secret version of Super-Reflexes.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Rarity changes
history.text: Gagamaru changed to Rare, Karasu Epic and Ness Legendary at that date; later announcements supersede some of these tiers.

history.title: Gagamaru and Chigiri revamp
history.text: Gagamaru gained Bear Claw awakening; Handstand and Diving Header merged at that date. Chigiri also revamped.
